ios.desc:
With Avec, email goes from a chore to a 1-minute ritual. Avec shows you the emails that matter first, one at a time, and lets you reply with your voice. Free, works with your existing Gmail accounts (personal and work).

YOUR PERSONALIZED EMAIL ALGORITHM
Avec prioritizes your inbox and shows your important emails one by one. No more scrolling past important messages buried under newsletters and promos. Importance is learned per sender from what you do, and you can override it on any email. Prefer a regular inbox? Switch to List view anytime.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT TELL THE WHOLE STORY
Stay on top of things without opening your inbox. Avec’s notifications are judicious, and summarize what an email says and what needs your attention, right on your lock screen. Choose alerts for your highest-priority messages, every important email, or just login codes. 

REPLY WITH VOICE
Use voice to send emails in seconds. Say a few key points and let Avec draft a perfect email for you. Review it, tweak it with voice, and send.

ALL YOUR GMAIL IN ONE PLACE
Add your work, personal, and side-project Gmail accounts and triage them as one. Each card shows which account it came from, and one tap filters down to just that account when you want to focus. And search all of them at once when you’re not sure where to find an email.

SWIPE TO ZERO
One at a time, in no time. Swipe through your Stack the way you swipe through everything else on your phone (yes, it’s like Tinder for email). Swipe right for Done, left to save for Later, down to stop hearing from a sender. Changed your mind? Undo. Get to inbox zero in seconds, no discipline needed.

KEEP YOUR CALENDAR UP-TO-DATE, NO EFFORT NEEDED
Meetings, reservations, flights; Avec finds plans in your email and adds them to Google Calendar. Review suggestions yourself, or turn on automatic adding to keep your calendar up to date as plans change.

YOUR GMAIL, YOUR RULES
Avec is a layer on top of Gmail, not a replacement for it. You decide what happens in Gmail when you swipe: archive, or just mark as read and keep in your inbox. Nothing is sent, archived, or deleted without your permission.

NOTHING FALLS THROUGH THE CRACKS
Mark emails you can’t handle yet as Todo. Avec reads them and suggests the date itself, so “can you get this to me by Thursday” reminds you on Thursday without you setting anything. When a Todo comes due it returns to the top of your Stack and reminds you.

quotes.text:
Hi HN!

A few friends & I have just spent the past ~2 years building a new kind of email app for iOS. It's now available in GA and we think some of you might find it interesting.

Why another email app, you ask? We think that while many interesting attempts at one-upping Gmail were made in the past 25 years, no one could really solve the core problem we all experience with email: information overload.

Of course, LLMs have completely changed that, as they finally offer a path to do refined triage of your inbox. However, as anyone who's tried the AI features most email apps offer nowadays, they feel tacked-on and rarely are useful.

That is why this took us ~2 years: we rebuilt an email app from the ground up, thinking about where we could thoughtfully and usefully leverage LLMs. Some of our faves:

- AI-based prioritization

- Voice-based email drafting that takes a few words from you and embellishes them into a polished email

- Very actionable, to-the-point notifications that don't force you to open the app to know what's up

Ultimately, while we tried hard to make a really great app, our goal is for you to spend as little time in it as possible. Ergo our tagline: we'd like to let you handle your inbox in seconds and get back to your life.
